privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Pohnch shows a child's school van on the parent's phone. We keep as little as we can, and only the right people see it.
privacy.collect.title: What we keep
privacy.collect.body: Parents: mobile number, the name you choose, language. Children: first name only, school, and the home spot you place on the map yourself. Drivers: mobile number, name, van name, school, number plate and stops. During trips: the van's location and the driver's taps (when, and by whom). Your phone's notification token, to send alerts.
privacy.never.title: What we never keep
privacy.never.body: A child's photo, phone number or gender. The parent's phone location (the parent app never asks for it). The van's location outside trips. We don't sell data and show no ads.
privacy.who.title: Who sees what
privacy.who.body: Parents see only their own child, their own van, its location during trips, and their own stop; never other families' stops. Drivers see only the first names and stops of the children on their van. The Pohnch team can see it to help and to check drivers.
privacy.keep.title: How long
privacy.keep.body: The van's location is deleted automatically after 30 days. To delete your account and your children's details, write to us on WhatsApp and we'll delete them within 7 days.
privacy.safe.title: Keeping it safe
privacy.safe.body: Every table has access rules: each person can read only their own rows. Invite links are stored only in scrambled (hashed) form, never the link itself. Names, numbers and links are never written to logs.
privacy.contact.title: Contact
privacy.contact.body: Questions or complaints: WhatsApp 0300 1478729. If this policy changes, we'll tell you in the app.

location.disclosure.title: Why location?
location.disclosure.body: Pohnch Driver collects the van's location during a trip so that the van's families can see it on a map, even when the app is closed or not in use. Location is collected only from Start trip until End trip, never at other times, and is deleted after 30 days.
